# How-To Geek

> How-To Geek provides practical technology guides, reviews, news, and expert advice covering hardware, software, operating systems, and consumer tech.

How-To Geek is a comprehensive technology resource offering in-depth guides, product reviews, buying recommendations, and breaking tech news. The site covers everything from PC hardware and networking to streaming services, smart home devices, and DIY projects, serving both casual users and tech enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- Windows
- Linux
- Hardware Reviews
- Product Reviews
- Streaming Services
- Smart Home
- Networking
- Open Source
- Web Development
- Home Server
- Cord-Cutting
- Android
- DIY Projects
- NAS/Storage
- How-To Guides

## Core & News

- [How-To Geek Homepage](https://www.howtogeek.com): How-To Geek homepage: technology guides, reviews, tips, and answers
- [Technology News](https://www.howtogeek.com/news): Latest technology news and analysis covering Windows, Linux, software
- [New Tech Coverage](https://www.howtogeek.com/new-tech): New tech coverage: smart home, 3D printing, DIY gadgets, reviews

## Operating Systems & Software

- [Operating Systems](https://www.howtogeek.com/operating-systems): Windows, Linux guides: installation, customization, distros, how-tos
- [Software](https://www.howtogeek.com/software): Software guides: development tools, Docker, PowerToys, productivity apps
- [Applications](https://www.howtogeek.com/applications): Application guides: Excel, Docker, self-hosted tools, software reviews

## Hardware & Components

- [PC Hardware](https://www.howtogeek.com/pc-hardware): PC hardware news, reviews, and guides for NVMe, SSD, DIY building
- [Components](https://www.howtogeek.com/components): PC components guides: GPU, CPU, SSD recommendations and comparisons
- [Peripherals](https://www.howtogeek.com/peripherals): Peripherals guide: monitors, gaming gear, USB accessories, printers
- [Storage and NAS](https://www.howtogeek.com/storage-and-nas): NAS, SSD, NVMe storage guides and RAID configuration tutorials
- [Single-Board Computers](https://www.howtogeek.com/sbc): Raspberry Pi, ESP32 guides: DIY projects, tutorials, hardware setup
- [Audio/Video](https://www.howtogeek.com/audio-video): Audio/video guides: headphones, speakers, TVs, home theater setup

## Networking & Home Infrastructure

- [Networking](https://www.howtogeek.com/networking): Networking guides covering Wi-Fi 7, routers, homelab setup, security

## Streaming & Entertainment

- [Streaming](https://www.howtogeek.com/streaming): Streaming guides: devices, apps, TV shows, recommendations, Plex
- [Streaming Platforms](https://www.howtogeek.com/streaming-platforms): Streaming platform guides: Plex, Netflix, Roku, cord-cutting tips
- [Streaming Content](https://www.howtogeek.com/streaming-content): Streaming content: movie recommendations, Netflix guides, TV picks

## Buying Guides & Deals

- [Buying Guides](https://www.howtogeek.com/buying-guides): Expert buying guides: VPNs, tech recommendations, comparison reviews
- [Tech Deals](https://www.howtogeek.com/deals): Expert-curated tech deals on smartphones, gadgets, smart home products

## Optional

- [Newsletter Subscription](https://www.howtogeek.com/page/newsletter): Newsletter subscription for tech tips, deals, reviews, Linux, Android
